executive_summary: The chain demonstrates genuine cumulative work: ResearchBrief identified declining feature adoption and active users with rising session frequency; RecoveryDesignSpecification transformed this into a consent-safe Signal Garden email experience; RecoveryRoomArtefact implemented the design with evidence-bound signals and optional clarification; CommunicationPlan delivered a proportionate, consent-safe invitation. All stages cite and transform their predecessor rather than restating it.
rationale: The chain is coherent, evidence is traceable, and the customer-facing plan is proportionate and consent-safe. Each stage contributes concrete value: ResearchBrief provides observations and hypotheses; Designer creates the Signal Garden thesis and journey; Maker implements the artefact with exact data bindings; Communicator crafts an email invitation that preserves aggregate framing and avoids persuasion. Trust dimensions are satisfied: evidence traceability is explicit via citations; consent and human control are honored through optional, purpose-limited interactions; claim discipline is maintained with no invented or causal claims; accessibility and safety meet WCAG 2.2 AA. The Communicator did not pause the plan for revision, so approval is appropriate.

chain_assessment.cumulative_contribution: Provided forensic observations of declining feature adoption (41.04% to 29.08%) and active users (141 to 120) alongside rising session frequency (3.77 to 4.85), identified one open medium-severity workflow support case with negative sentiment, and established consent boundaries permitting email outreach for recovery and personalisation under preference profile.

Transformed research insights into the Signal Garden thesis: a spatial email doorway to an inspectable signal garden where usage patterns are revealed as tangible strands without interpretation, honoring agency through optional clarification and evidence-grounded design principles.

Implemented the Signal Garden artefact with exact evidence bindings for all signals (feature adoption, active users, session frequency, seat utilisation) and the open support case, built inspect-only strands, optional clarification modal with explicit consent, and success banner, all meeting WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and reduced motion standards.

Crafted a plain-spoken, evidence-disciplined email invitation that presents aggregate signals as inspect-only objects, clarifies the optional and purpose-limited nature of observation sharing, and includes a transparency section explaining data boundaries and complete decline paths without implied obligation.

evidence_traceability.finding: Every claim in the chain is bound to exact evidence keys from the ResearchBrief, with no invention or calculation beyond cited values; data bindings in the artefact and claims in the communication plan trace directly to source evidence.

consent_and_human_control.finding: Email outreach is permitted by preference profile; clarification and observation sharing require explicit user action; all decline paths (non-engagement, 'Not now', modal dismiss) are honored without side effects or follow-up.

claim_discipline.finding: All claims describe observable, aggregate signals or case details without inferring causality, vulnerability, or protected traits; no outcome promises, urgency, or persuasion is used.

accessibility_and_safety.finding: The artefact implements WCAG 2.2 AA standards for contrast, focus, keyboard navigation, screen-reader access, and reduced motion; the communication plan contains no prohibited channels or urgency/scarcity/fear language.

human_review_focus: Verify that the email invitation body contains only aggregate-level framing and avoids any personal, individual, diagnostic, or causal language.
Confirm that all claims in the email and transparency section are traceable to exact source evidence without added interpretation.
Ensure the CTA is limited to viewing the Signal Garden and free of any request to book, buy, upgrade, call, or share data beyond optional observation sharing.

Check that the transparency section fully explains why the email was received, the data boundary (account-level observations only), and the complete decline path (email non-engagement, 'Not now' in modal, or modal dismiss) with no implied obligation.
Validate that no prohibited channels (SMS, phone, push) or urgency/scarcity/fear language appear in the draft.

boundaries: Never send email, launch a campaign or contact a customer.
Never publish, deploy or expose any artefact outside this review.
Never mutate, delete or transfer customer, billing or account data.
Never self-approve; an approval only clears the chain for a named human decision.
Never take an autonomous external action; every downstream effect waits for explicit human approval.
